status: read-only initial review; no 1.71 implementation or acceptance yet

observations.source: server/main.go: issueResumeToken, validateAndConsumeResumeToken; server/client_dispatch.go: login/resume; server/network.go: cleanupClientLocked
observations.finding: Resume tokens are currently issued with a five-minute deadline at login/rotation, while disconnected entity expiry uses five minutes from disconnect. No token extension or rotation on disconnect was found in the initial call-site search.
observations.next: Add a bounded server-clock regression for a connection played longer than five minutes before losing transport. Review exact-current-owner cleanup, takeover and token consumption races before changing the lifecycle. Preserve the separate owner-approved fifteen-minute dungeon progress rule. Do not solve this with a long sleep or campaign run.

observations.finding: Login and registration have a five-per-minute bucket owned by each Client. Fresh connections receive fresh buckets; initial review found no cross-connection authentication budget.
observations.next: Bound credential/hash work and cross-connection abuse without permanent account lockouts or penalizing all players behind a shared proxy. Verify actual proxy trust and deployment before relying on a source-address key.

observations.finding: requestIP prefers the leftmost X-Forwarded-For. The deployed template appends proxy_add_x_forwarded_for and independently sets X-Real-IP. Arbitrary client prefixes can therefore affect the reported source. Currently the examined requestIP call site is suspicious logging, not an authentication IP limiter.
observations.next: Review trusted proxy configuration and canonical source parsing before adding IP-based admission controls. Do not trust arbitrary forwarding headers or silently alter live networking.

retainedControls: CSPRNG 32-byte resume tokens, one token per account, rotation revokes the previous token, single-use consumption and explicit active-session takeover checks.
bcrypt password hashes, message payload limits and per-client admission policies, character-work locking, fresh trusted role checks and reversible audited administration.
Current alpha access, saved accounts, casino policy and payment exclusion remain unchanged.
publication: Continue ordered acceptance of prepared 1.62.1 through 1.70 first. This preflight is not a security certification or proof that every account/recovery path has been audited.
